_doc: Knock-over trackside props (scripts/props/prop_body.gd). Frame: origin at the centre of the base on the ground, +Y up, +X forward. shape 'frustum': height (m) and radius [bottom, top] (m); 'box': size [x, y, z] (m), base on the ground. mass kg; cg: height of the centre of mass above the base (m); inertia [x, y, z] kg m^2 about the centre of mass, principal (optional: computed for a uniform solid when absent); restitution and friction against the ground, walls and cars; drag_area: drag coefficient x frontal area (m^2); color: presentation only.

bollard.name: Delineator post on a rubber base
